ProfilePage.title: Profile｜Takuya Oshima
ProfilePage.profileText:
Web Designer, Front-end Engineer
Born in 1989.

I have spent 13 years at a web design and development company in Tokyo, creating a wide range of websites — from corporate sites and e-commerce to business systems and multilingual websites.

My strength lies in handling the entire process single-handedly: planning, design, development, and post-launch maintenance. Since you work with the same person from the first consultation to delivery, what you envision is exactly what gets built.

I go beyond simply making things look good. I take the time to understand your goals and target audience, then propose structures and designs that deliver results. I also offer SEO, page speed optimization, and ongoing updates and improvements after launch.

This website was independently planned, designed, and developed as a personal project, and has received international web design awards: four honors from CSS Design Awards, an Awwwards Nominee, and a CSS Winner STAR.

Feel free to get in touch about your website project — I'd be happy to discuss it.
